title: Bad Brains: the band that added some much-needed color to the American rock scene (Bruce Britt, Andscape, 7 February 2017)
notes: 'A black band that cut its teeth learning jazz fusion songs by Weather Report and Lonnie Liston Smith'; 'They had Mahavishnu Orchestra/Return to Forever kind of chops'; Dave Grohl 'has confessed that the drum volley that opens Nirvana's revolutionary 1991 "Smells Like Teen Spirit" was inspired by Earl Hudson'.

title: Bad Brains - Banned in DC - CBGB 1982 (Hardcore Worldwide, official version, YouTube)
notes: Colour film of the band at CBGB in 1982: Hudson at the kit in close-up at the start, in a knitted red, gold and green Rasta tam and a golden-yellow T-shirt with a dark lion print, a moustache and short beard, a kit with chrome-like shells and chrome hardware.
